visual_review.identity: Darker muted olive/gray-green continuous meadow with six small scattered pale blue-white flower groups and sparse simple grass marks. Original floral identity retained without added soil patches, rocks or tall shrubs.
visual_review.style_review: Strong match to approved meadow-base broad planes and low-density accents. Faint brush/cloud texture and more than six-to-ten secondary contour regions remain; flowers have recognizable petal/stem detail but are bounded in six groups, not uniform white confetti.
visual_review.palette_caveat: More saturated/green and brighter than original dark olive floral swatch, but visibly darker than new meadow2/3 and close to approved base. Exact original palette match is not claimed.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Flower groups roughly80-120 native pixels,8-12 logical at128 or16-24 at256. Individual blossoms stay small; source remains catalog-only.
visual_review.native_acceptance: Opaque catalog tone3 candidate;128/256 preview and actual scene acceptance pending, no natural seamlessness claim.
